methodology: At every date, fit PCA, matrix-exponential AR, joint spot equation, and innovation covariance using only observations through that date.
controlled_ablation: frozen_state sets only G=0; PCA, factor scales, current residual, spot coefficients, innovation covariance, Sobol nodes, instruments, entry bid/ask, and optimization constraints are identical
realized_strategy: report both expiry-sliced option-derived delta returns and direct entry-net-delta/sign spot holdings to the evaluation horizon
